title: Firebase Push ID
summary: A Firebase Realtime Database push key is a 20-character, chronologically sortable string built from an 8-byte timestamp (milliseconds since epoch, base64-ish) followed by 12 bytes of randomness.

notes: 8 bytes of timestamp (milliseconds) encoded as 8 chars of a URL-safe alphabet.
12 bytes of randomness encoded as 12 chars.
Total 20 characters; lexicographically sortable by time.
